flow.name: axn-term perf - static sizes
flow.description: Release binary and frontend bundle sizes (what gets parsed before the first render).

assert.name: static.entry_js_kb
assert.description: Entry JS stays under 3 MB (Monaco must stay lazy)

flow.name: axn-term perf - startup fresh
flow.description: Cold start with an empty state dir: Rust up, window, shell spawned, first prompt; memory and idle CPU.

step.description: Start the app 7 times with a fresh state

assert.name: startup.fresh.idle_cpu_pct
assert.description: Idle CPU under 10 % of a core

flow.name: axn-term perf - startup restore 12 (selected first)
flow.description: Restore of 12 saved sessions (200 KB scrollback each) with the first one selected.

step.description: Start the app 5 times restoring 12 sessions

flow.name: axn-term perf - startup restore 12 (selected last)
flow.description: Same restore, but the selected session is last in the render order — catches work done for hidden sessions first.

step.description: Start the app 5 times restoring 12 sessions, last one selected

flow.name: axn-term perf - startup phases
flow.description: Where startup time goes, from the app's AXN_TERM_PERF_TRACE: exec, Rust init, window, webview load, JS eval, React mount, state load, terminal open, PTY spawn, shell start, first paint.

step.description: Trace 7 starts and split them into phases

assert.description: The binary supports the perf trace and phases were measured

assert.name: phases.total_ms
assert.description: Spawn to first painted output within 3 s

assert.name: phases.external_requests
assert.description: No requests to outside hosts at startup

flow.name: axn-term perf - throughput
flow.description: Heavy output: cat of 32 MB plain text, cat of 16 MB coloured text, seq of 2M lines — time until the shell is done and until everything is on screen, CPU per process.

assert.name: throughput.cat_plain_32mb.screen_ms
assert.description: 32 MB cat on screen within 15 s

flow.name: axn-term perf - ctrl-c during flood
flow.description: Ctrl-C after 1.5 s of unbounded output: how fast the prompt is back and the screen has caught up (flow control).

assert.name: interrupt.screen_ms
assert.description: Screen settles within 5 s of Ctrl-C

flow.name: axn-term perf - keystroke echo
flow.description: Key written to the PTY until its echo is back in the app (PTY path, without the UI).

step.description: Type 100 keys and time each echo

flow.name: axn-term perf - session switch
flow.description: Only the selected session mounts a terminal, so every switch serializes the old scrollback, disposes xterm + renderer, mounts fresh and replays. Measures select → remount latency and RSS drift across the run.

assert.name: switch.term_open_ms
assert.description: Remount within 2 s of the select command

assert.name: switch.rss_delta_mb
assert.description: No more than 100 MB RSS growth across the run

flow.name: axn-term perf - restore storm
flow.description: 12 restored sessions whose shells each print 256 KB before their first prompt: wall time until the app is quiet, CPU, peak memory and the main-thread stalls the output handlers cause.

flow.name: axn-term perf - output reaches the frontend
flow.description: Correctness guard for the output pipeline: 3 MB of output followed by a marker must arrive in the frontend's session output.

step.description: Print 3 MB and a marker, find it in the frontend state
